facts.fact: Indian citizens who are 18 on a qualifying date (1 January, 1 April, 1 July or 1 October of the roll revision year) can register as voters
facts.quote: Election commission of India offers online voter registration for Indian citizens who have attained the age of 18 on the qualifying date (1 Jan, 1 April, 1 July and 1 Oct of the year of revision of electoral roll).

facts.fact: A new voter registers by filling Form 6
facts.quote: General Voters need to fill Form 6 (Link to online form). This is only for the Registration of new voters.

facts.fact: Apply online on ECI's Voters' Service Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) or through the Voter Helpline App
facts.quote: Visit https://voters.eci.gov.in for voter registration. Also, you can use Voter Helpline App (Android) and Voter Helpline App (iOS) to verify your name in Electoral Roll or register online.

behaviour: Explains registering with Form 6 through ECI voter services; cites eci.gov.in.
fail_if: It names a form other than Form 6 for a new voter, or gives no ECI citation.
summary: ECI FAQ: 18 on a qualifying date, Form 6 for new voters, online at voters.eci.gov.in or the Voter Helpline App.
